scope_limits: Transient processing metadata timing was tested with controlled transport; tiny real import completed between manual observations.
Live repeated book had 0% reading progress; this does not prove preservation of an arbitrary nonzero anchor. Existing unit/previous release evidence covers the relevant guards.
Unknown job/network/order failures were manually injected only on local actual page, not shared server.
Cleanup confirmed removal of two own QA memberships through app and fresh visible shelf; not a database/storage/job purge audit.
No deliberate logout or global identity change on the user browser; account switch/auth concurrency covered in isolated fixtures.
